Priya: Heads-up — Sofia handed in her resignation today. Last day 2026-06-18. Can we run through offboard checklist: device return, corporate card, benefits/401k rollover info, exit interview? Please use HR-12099.

Sofia: Confirmed. Happy to do KT and leave notes. I have a company card with pending vendor subscriptions and one billing contact at PartnerCo that needs transfer. Also on a managed 401k plan — how do I get rollover paperwork?

Elena (IT): Ticket HR-12099 created for device pickup + badge deprovision. Options: UPS pickup or drop-off. For admins, typical deprov commands below (please run after confirmed last day):
```
# suspend Okta user
okta-cli suspend-user sofia.martin@redwood.ai
# revoke AWS/GCP keys
aws iam list-access-keys --user-name sofia.martin --query 'AccessKeyMetadata[].AccessKeyId' --output text | xargs -r -n1 aws iam delete-access-key --user-name sofia.martin --access-key-id
for key in $(gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=sofia@redwood.ai --format="value(name)"); do gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete $key --iam-account=sofia@redwood.ai; done
```

Mark (Finance): Corporate card note — please list all active subscriptions tied to the card and any scheduled invoices. We will cancel the card after the final statement. Sofia, can you paste vendor list in the HR ticket (service | owner | next billing date)? Also, we need to get the physical card back; finance prefers returning to Ops or shredding via vendor.

Sofia: Posting short vendor list here now:
- PartnerCo invoicing | sofia@partnerco.com | 2026-06-20
- Amplitude | sofia@amplitude.com | 2026-07-01 (annual)
- Zendesk (shared seat) | billing@redwood.ai | recurring monthly
I'll add invoice copies to HR-12099. Card last four digits: 4321.

Kelsey: Benefits/401k: medical coverage runs through 06/30/2026 (policy = through month end). ADP will email COBRA packet within 14 days. For 401k rollover, our plan vendor will send distribution and rollover forms; Mark/Payroll will help with options. I'll DM Sofia the initial packet and confirm final paycheck + any accrued PTO payout timing in HR-12099.

Sam: Sofia holds ownership on two internal docs and runs the weekly vendor sync. I'll take over scheduling the sync for the month after her departure but need a short KT. Sofia, can you record a 10-12 min demo of the sync process + attach runbooks?

Sofia: I can upload runbooks and a screencap by EOD Tue. I'll also add the PartnerCo contact transfer steps and any API keys that need rotation.

Elena (IT): Quick ask: please post serial # of laptop and whether there's a company SIM so we can generate the label. Also list any admin/shared logins in table format (service | admin user | recommended replacement). We'll rotate creds and remove invites.

Sofia: Laptop serial: S0F1A-9988. No SIM. Shared admin list (partial):
- PagerDuty | sofia@redwood.ai | replacement: Mei
- Stripe dashboard admin | sofia@redwood.ai | replacement: FinanceOps
I'll DM sensitive creds to Elena.

Mark (Finance): Action re: card — once Sofia lists subscriptions in HR-12099, Finance will: 1) block card on termination date, 2) reassign invoice owners, 3) cancel auto-payments where appropriate. If a vendor must keep continuity, we'll set up new billing contact.

Carlos (Legal): FYI — if any vendor contracts require signatory changes or notices, flag them in HR-12099. Legal will prepare assignment language or novation if needed. Also confirm whether Sofia's PartnerCo agreement has any auto-renew clauses.

Sam: KT scheduling — proposing two 45m slots next week: Wed 9:30-10:15 PT and Thu 10:30-11:15 PT. Sofia, please confirm availability so I can invite Mei and FinanceOps.

Sofia: Both times work. Please add the invites.

peopleops-bot: Exit interview invite draft sent to Sofia + Priya — proposed 2026-06-16 10:00 AM PT. RSVP pending. Exit survey link included in HR-12099.

Kelsey: Payroll note — final paycheck + accrued PTO processed on the next payroll run after termination; I'll confirm the deposit date in HR-12099. For 401k, the vendor will need a signed distribution form; we'll share contact details.

Priya: Action summary (please update HR-12099 when complete):
- @Elena (IT): schedule pickup, generate return label, deprovision accounts on termination
- @Mark (Finance): block card on termination, reassign invoices, confirm vendor billing transfers
- @Kelsey: COBRA packet, payroll/401k rollover guidance, confirm final pay date
- @Sam: schedule KT sessions and collect runbooks/demos
- @Sofia: upload screencast, vendor invoices, post laptop serial and shared admin list in HR-12099
- @Carlos (Legal): review vendor contracts flagged in HR-12099

Sofia: Thanks everyone. I'll upload docs + invoice PDFs and confirm PartnerCo handoff by EOD Tue. Appreciate the help.

Priya: Thanks team  I'll close when HR-12099 is all green. :thumbsup:
